summary: Comprehensive implementation plan for IPMC-SimWeb: Web-Based Digital Twin for IPMC Soft Actuators, featuring Prandtl-Ishlinskii hysteresis modeling, Krejci-Kuhnen inverse feedforward compensation, discrete-time 2nd-order plant dynamics with drag, 4-way controller comparison (Open Loop, FF Only, FB Only, Hybrid), synthetic chirp benchmark generator, CSV data identification, physics-informed simulation, 2D cantilever bending animation, and scientific CSV/JSON export.
